title: GAZ's new single "More Than A Shooting Star" is a classic rock ballad about heartbreak
htmlContent:
GAZ’s new single, “More Than A Shooting Star,” is a beautiful song that captures the magic of brief, memorable connections that shine brightly before they fade away. This track is filled with deep emotions and a catchy melody.

GAZ’s heartfelt singing tells the story of a love that didn’t last but was still cherished. The electric guitars add a vibrant touch, while the piano, bass, and organ create a rich and welcoming sound. This song would fit perfectly on a classic rock playlist alongside artists like Tom Petty and The Eagles. This single is special because it highlights the beauty of fleeting moments. The uplifting chorus captures the bittersweet feeling of something slipping away, leaving you with a warm glow.

https://open.spotify.com/album/6ySfkeFHRocgDSqCf9S4Ut?si=RStqyFCWT0eqDW0kahZrBQ

The music embraces you, making it feel less like a farewell and more like a celebration of the good times shared. GAZ once again shows that powerful songs resonate deeply. With “More Than A Shooting Star,” he gives us a touching ballad that reminds us that some loves, like bright streaks in the night sky, are unforgettable.
